post.description:
Scale the endpoint down to zero replicas. Valid from any stage except
`Deleting`. A paused endpoint can be resumed with `POST /v2/endpoint/{namespace}/{name}/resume`.

Resume a previously paused or stopped endpoint. Valid from `Stopped`,
`Paused`, or `Runtime` error stages. Fails with
`400 "Endpoint is already running"` if the endpoint is already in
`Updating` or `Running` stage. Quota is re-checked at resume time.

Scale the endpoint down to zero replicas and mark it as `Stopped`.
The endpoint's spec must have scale-to-zero enabled
(`scaling.scaleToZeroTimeout` set); otherwise the call returns
`400 "workload cannot be scaled to zero"`. Not valid when the
workload is in the `Deleting` stage. Use `POST /resume` to wake
the endpoint back up.

get.description:
Cursor-based pagination split into two concerns:
- **Time window** (`since` / `until`, RFC 3339, inclusive): immutable filter carried across all paginated requests
  for a given view.
- **Cursor** (`after` / `before`): opaque pagination cursor produced by the API in the `Link` header. Clients MUST
  treat it as opaque.

`order` controls which side of the window `limit` cuts from (`desc` keeps the
newest, `asc` keeps the oldest). Response entries are always returned in
chronological (ascending) order regardless of `order`.

All log entries sharing a boundary millisecond are always included, even if
that exceeds `limit`.

Always returns `application/json`. For a kubectl-style line-per-log rendering,
use `/v3/endpoint/{namespace}/{name}/logs/download`.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search on log line

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor (from Link header). Do not construct.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor (from Link header). Do not construct.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc (default desc — keep newest of the window)

get.summary: Download endpoint logs as plain text (kubectl-style) [READ]
get.description:
Streams every log line matching the filters as `text/plain; charset=utf-8`,
chronologically ascending, with no pagination. Format per line:
`<timestamp> <replica> <level> <line>` — `level` defaults to `INFO`.

Sets `Content-Disposition: attachment` so a browser downloads the response
as a file. Capped at `MAX_DOWNLOAD_LINES` for safety; narrow `since`/`until`
if you need more.

cacheHttpResponses.description:
Enable caching of successful HTTP responses. When enabled, responses are
cached with a 60min TTL (reset on each cache hit) and served instantly
on identical requests. With 100% cache hit rates, endpoints can
automatically scale to zero while still serving cached responses,
optimizing both latency and cost. Cache hits are indicated by the
'x-cache: HIT' response header, and requests can bypass the cache using
'x-use-cache: false'.
Currently only available for HuggingFace Admins.
